notes.title: Playable on Steam Deck!
notes.content:
Noah's Dilemma is now playable on Steam Deck!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44849650/33276e83d8d8755a1ed4451987d73ac86df409a7.jpg[/img]

The controller support is not perfect yet, but for now, you can safely play the entire game on your Steam Deck.

Please try to avoid touching the screen while playing, for the touch input might mess up the gamepad input and cause unintended behavior. Also, remember to set your Button Layout to using a Gamepad Template in advance!

If you can play Noah's Dilemma on a desktop, I'd still recommend using mouse and keyboard at the moment. Thanks!


GP

notes.title: DEMO OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I'm thrilled to announce that after 15 months of hard work, the demo of Noah's Dilemma is finally ready to see the light of day!

Dive into a sudoku-inspired roguelike adventure across the furious seas.

[previewyoutube=qkKwcIQH40U;full][/previewyoutube]

In this demo, you can look forward to:

[list]
[*] 1 of the 4 sea areas with a governing boss.
[*] 20 unique creatures.
[*] 40 diverse encounters.
[*] 40 items to collect.
[*] 80 powerful relics.
[/list]

In short, it’s almost like the full game—but for now, you’ll only experience the first map.

[h2]Play now:[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2775160/


While I’ve worked hard to ensure this demo is as polished and bug-free as possible, if you do encounter any issues, please don’t hesitate to leave a comment here, on the discussion board, or—preferably—join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/ZxmFQmqgpj]Discord[/url] to report them.

I’d also love to hear your feedback and suggestions! As I’m still actively working on the final 10% of content and balancing the meta, your input could shape the game. Feel free to join me on [url=https://discord.com/invite/ZxmFQmqgpj]Discord[/url] and get involved in the process.

Thank you for your support, and I hope you enjoy playing Noah's Dilemma!

Follow me for more updates: [url=https://bsky.app/profile/cguanpeng.com]Bluesky[/url] / [url=https://x.com/cguanpeng]Twitter[/url]


GP
